wererat.desc: hybrid rat-humanoid with gray fur, rat head and tail, tattered clothing, bolt case on the belt

weretiger.desc: hybrid tiger-humanoid with striped orange fur and tiger head, tattered clothing, arrow quiver on the back

werewolf.desc: hybrid wolf-humanoid with gray fur, wolf head, clawed hands and tattered clothing, arrow quiver on the back

white-dragon-wyrmling.desc: four-legged winged arctic dragon with icy white scales, sharp beaked head and spiny crest, hatchling proportions with oversized head and eyes

wight.desc: undead warrior with dried gray skin, glowing eyes, corroded armor, scabbard at the hip and an arrow quiver on the back

will-o-wisp.desc: small floating orb of flickering pale-blue light with a faint ghostly glow

winter-wolf.desc: large wolf with white-blue frosty fur and icy breath

worg.desc: huge evil wolf with dark gray fur and glowing eyes

wraith.desc: floating hooded figure of black tattered shadow-robes with glowing eyes and no legs

wyvern.desc: dragon-like creature with two legs, bat wings as forelimbs, long neck and a venomous scorpion-like tail stinger, brown-green scales

xorn.desc: barrel-shaped stone-skinned creature with three thick legs, three clawed arms, three eyes and a wide mouth on top

young-black-dragon.desc: four-legged winged swamp-dwelling dragon with glossy black scales, skull-like face with forward-curving horns, acid dripping from jaws, lean adolescent build

young-blue-dragon.desc: four-legged winged desert dragon with deep blue scales, a single large horn on its snout, frilled ears, crackling lightning, lean adolescent build

young-brass-dragon.desc: four-legged winged desert metallic dragon with brass-gold scales and a broad blade-shaped head crest, lean adolescent build

young-bronze-dragon.desc: four-legged winged coastal metallic dragon with bronze scales, ridged fin-like frill and webbed claws, lean adolescent build

young-copper-dragon.desc: four-legged winged metallic dragon with copper scales, segmented back-swept horns and a lean agile build, lean adolescent build

young-gold-dragon.desc: four-legged winged regal sinuous metallic dragon with gold scales, whisker-like barbels and sail-like wings, lean adolescent build

young-green-dragon.desc: four-legged winged forest dragon with emerald scales and a tall crest frill running from head down the spine, lean adolescent build

young-red-dragon.desc: four-legged winged volcanic dragon with crimson scales, massive swept-back horns and smoke wisping from its nostrils, lean adolescent build

young-silver-dragon.desc: four-legged winged metallic dragon with gleaming silver scales, smooth head frill and a beak-like chin spike, lean adolescent build

young-white-dragon.desc: four-legged winged arctic dragon with icy white scales, sharp beaked head and spiny crest, lean adolescent build

zombie.desc: shambling rotting human corpse with torn clothing and gray-green skin
